title: lockflight.blocked/v1
description: "I stopped and a person must do something": written by the CI judge (in its evidence), the engine's refusals that need a person, the crew skills and a later autonomous mode. Advice for a person, never proof. Reason codes, who and action grow by addition: a reader shows an unknown value as it is and decides nothing on it (lockflight blocked validate reports it). A need never carries a command: renderers derive it from the reason, the action and the feature.
